title: L1-inception-task-generator Output
description: Items carry per-task meta-points only (structural fields stay full: ids, type, effort, dependency links). The full task breakdown narrative (why a feature was split this way, detailed task descriptions) lives ONLY in artifacts[0] (task-breakdown.md). Any *_summary/summary string here is a distillation (<=150 chars), never a copy of the artifact text.

tasks.description: One entry per generated task, grouped implicitly by feature_id.

gaps.description: Features that could not be decomposed (too vague, contradictory, or missing description).

source_reference.description: Which input this task was derived from, e.g. 'features.json' or 'acceptance-criteria.json'.

source_location.description: Locator within that source, e.g. feature id or acceptance-criteria index.

task_id.description: Task id, format T-{epic}.{feature_seq}.{task_seq}, e.g. T-01.1.01. Prefix before the final segment matches the parent feature_id.

title.description: Short imperative task title, e.g. 'Build POST /identity/merge endpoint'.

effort_hours.description: Estimated effort in hours. Must not exceed max_task_effort_hours — if it would, the feature must be split into more tasks instead.

blocks_task_ids.description: Task ids that cannot start until this one is done (intra- or cross-feature).

blocked_by_task_ids.description: Task ids this task is waiting on.

summary.description: Distilled one-line description of the task. Full detail is in the artifact only.

duplicate_flag.description: True if tool-L1-jira-fetch-issue found a likely-duplicate task in the adjacent backlog (only set when adjacent_backlog_check=true).
